what: Small photos scattered around the center sentence follow the mouse over the board, lagging by (cursor − screen center) ÷ 100 px with .5s linear easing, and the reverse marker (data-dir="-1") photos move in reverse for a staggered depth between photos. Photos given data-y flow tied to scroll (scrub) by that % of their height while passing through the sheet

options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Piece to animate — data-dir (1 · -1), data-y (scroll %, if none it is not tied to scroll)
options.div: Value dividing cursor distance, default 100 (larger moves less)

from.where: index.html .ms-ai (four photos around the “Ask AI” sentence — original scatteredImages mouseMove)
